0022600223.text: The Brooklyn Nets (2-8, on a two-game losing streak, 13th in the East) visit the New Orleans Pelicans (4-7, on a three-game losing streak, 12th in the West) in the Nets' 11th game of the season, with Brooklyn holding a 1-5 road record. Brooklyn is without Mikel Brown Jr. (illness; 12.9 points and 23.2 minutes per game this season) and Nolan Traore (calf soreness), while New Orleans is missing Bennedict Mathurin (thumb sprain), Trendon Watford (ankle sprain), Trey Murphy III (knee tendinitis) and Yves Missi (knee bruise). The teams have not played yet in the 2026-27 season, and their 2025-26 season series was split 1-1, with the most recent meeting on January 14, 2026 in New Orleans, where the Nets lost 116-113.
